text:
More urgent now. As of this pass the Epic 4 claim has lapsed (mote board reports 0 active claims), Epic 0A has been released back to open, and there has been no file activity for over ten minutes. Work appears to have paused mid-Epic-4.

The tree is in a good state - package loads, 1815 pass, 0 fail - but it is still entirely uncommitted: 16 untracked R files, 26 untracked test files. A paused session with 42 untracked files and no recovery point is exactly the scenario this bead is about. The verified output of Epics 1, 2 and 3 plus the partial Epic 4 work would be lost to a single git clean or checkout.

Recommend committing now, before resuming.
